ucs.title: [LLM] Turla ComRAT v4 webmail C2 — non-browser process beaconing to Gmail/Outlook web services
ucs.description: Hunts Turla's ComRAT v4 (Agent.BTZ/Chinch lineage) tradecraft of using a legitimate webmail service (Gmail web UI, Outlook) as a bidirectional C2 channel from an injected, non-browser process (typically explorer.exe/svchost.exe). Turla characteristically blends C2 into trusted SaaS endpoints to defeat domain-reputation and proxy controls.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Network_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest IN ("mail.google.com","www.googleapis.com","mail.live.com","outlook.office365.com") AND NOT All_Traffic.process_name IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","iexplore.exe","outlook.exe","onedrive.exe","teams.exe","msteams.exe","thunderbird.exe") by All_Traffic.src, All_Traffic.dest, All_Traffic.process_name, All_Traffic.user, All_Traffic.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | where process_name!="" | sort - count
ucs.kql:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
// ComRAT C2 rides legit webmail endpoints — flag when a NON-browser process reaches them
| where RemoteUrl has_any ("mail.google.com","www.googleapis.com","mail.live.com","outlook.office365.com")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","iexplore.exe","outlook.exe","onedrive.exe","teams.exe","msteams.exe","thunderbird.exe","officeclicktorun.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp), Conns=count(), Endpoints=make_set(RemoteUrl,10)
          by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
// recurring beacon from a host process (explorer/svchost) is the ComRAT signal
| where Conns >= 3
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Turla ComRAT-style non-browser process beaconing to webmail C2
id: 8f1c2d4a-7e9b-4c2a-9b3d-1a2b3c4d5e6f
status: experimental
description: Detects a non-browser process making network connections to legitimate webmail web services, consistent with Turla ComRAT v4 bidirectional web-service C2.
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    DestinationHostname|contains:
      - mail.google.com
      - www.googleapis.com
      - mail.live.com
      - outlook.office365.com
  filter_browsers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\brave.exe'
      - '\iexplore.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\onedrive.exe'
      - '\teams.exe'
      - '\thunderbird.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter_browsers
level: medium
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1102.002
  - attack.t1071.003
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 (@DestinationHostname:(*mail.google.com OR *googleapis.com OR *mail.live.com OR *outlook.office365.com)) -@Image:(*\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\MsEdge.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\Firefox.exe OR *\iexplore.exe OR *\outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\onedrive.exe OR *\OneDrive.exe OR *\teams.exe OR *\Teams.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(mail\.google\.com|googleapis\.com|mail\.live\.com|outlook\.office365\.com)/i
| NOT (ContextImageFileName=/\\(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|iexplore|outlook|onedrive|teams|thunderbird)\.exe$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=count())
| count > 2
ucs.rationale: Generic SaaS-C2 hunts trigger on the destination alone and drown in legitimate Gmail/Outlook usage. This is Turla-specific because it pivots on the *initiating process*: ComRAT v4 (Microsoft 'Secret Blizzard') injects into explorer.exe/svchost and drives the Gmail web UI as a covert mailbox-based channel, so a host process — not a browser — talking to mail.google.com is the anomalous discriminator

ucs.title: [LLM] Turla PowerStallion — PowerShell backdoor mounting OneDrive WebDAV (d.docs.live.net) as C2
ucs.description: Hunts Turla's PowerStallion lightweight PowerShell loader, which maps a Microsoft OneDrive WebDAV share (d.docs.live.net / DavWWWRoot via '@SSL') and loops PowerShell to pull/stage the Carbon or Mosquito backdoor. The combination of net/WebDAV mounting to OneDrive driven by PowerShell is a documented, distinctive Turla chain.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe") AND (Processes.process="*d.docs.live.net*" OR Processes.process="*DavWWWRoot*" OR Processes.process="*@SSL*" OR Processes.process="*onedrive.live.com*") by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_name, Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe")
// PowerStallion mounts OneDrive over WebDAV: d.docs.live.net + DavWWWRoot/@SSL
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("d.docs.live.net","DavWWWRoot","@SSL","onedrive.live.com")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, FolderPath, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where TargetProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe")
| where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("d.docs.live.net","DavWWWRoot","@SSL","onedrive.live.com")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:

id: 3b9d6e1f-2c4a-4d7e-8a5b-6c7d8e9f0a1b
status: experimental
description: Detects PowerShell or net.exe referencing the OneDrive WebDAV endpoint d.docs.live.net / DavWWWRoot / @SSL, consistent with Turla PowerStallion staging C2.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows

      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
  selection_webdav:

      - 'd.docs.live.net'
      - 'DavWWWRoot'

      - 'onedrive.live.com'

level: high
tags:

  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1102.002
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\net.exe OR *\net1.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\RUNDLL32.EXE)) @CommandLine:(*d.docs.live.net* OR *DavWWWRoot* OR *@SSL* OR *onedrive.live.com*)
